failure_modes: The landmark_00_soft_mass trajectory shape and peak location are unchanged under W2_middle_peak relative to uniform dose, falsifying H001.
Early-window rate contrasts of landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dy do not differ between W2_middle_peak and the registered time-order controls, falsifying H002.
Requested dose is not delivered as compiled (realized-dose trace deviates from the registered table), so the comparison is uninterpretable.
Primary affinity does not improve, or strain/structural validity degrades, despite verified dose delivery.
Rare-path coverage or early compatible paths are lost under the middle-weighted schedule relative to the constant policy.
The observed rise-then-fall pattern is clone/batch noise rather than a real time-dependent coordinate contrast, so no schedule difference is detectable.
result.rationale: Adopting H001 and H002. H001's landmark_00_soft_mass curve (Eef4385e476674774) shows a within-window rise-then-fall pattern with a peak near t=0.15-0.16 and decline toward the end of the observed score window [0.0,0.49] (E0857891f4effbfe1), and H002's landmark_00_local_dx (E4bbe368c52deda38) and landmark_00_local_dy (E11ca33646f5d0576) show non-monotone, sign-changing trajectories with large first-vs-last rate contrasts. Both hypotheses predict that a schedule weighting dose toward the early-to-middle portion of the window and reducing it late should be distinguishable from uniform dose. Among the registered dose recipes, W2_middle_peak (dose [0.5,1.5,0.5] over knots [0,0.5,1], smoothstep, mean-one normalized, same M2 reward, delta and blend unchanged) is the offered policy that concentrates dose in the middle of the observed window while keeping positive guidance throughout, matching the observed peak location and the early-to-middle emphasis implied by the adopted hypotheses. W1_early_soft and W3_early_strong_control are the registered time-order controls and are not selected as the primary test. This is a dose-route edit only: the coordinate reward family, teacher matching, temperatures, delta and eta are preserved, and no spatial force is inferred from the time derivative of these curves.
